name: UAE
dataProvenance: UAE Personal Status Law (Federal Law No. 28/2005), DIFC Wills and Probate Registry, Federal Decree-Law No. 41/2022
description: UAE dual-track succession — Sharia default vs DIFC common law for non-Muslims. DWSC registered wills, expatriate estate handling.

conformanceRules.description: Succession track (sharia or difc) must be specified

keyFeatures: Sharia default rules, DIFC Wills Service Centre, free zone asset treatment, non-Muslim will registration, homeCountryLawElection (Decree Law 41/2022), home country code + DIFC registration tracking, marriageRevocation (no general rule for DIFC/ADGM non-Muslim wills)
